english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act of adjusting or for a deliberate fine-tuning, while 調賬 is more specific in accounting.
Use this for adjusting an amount, position, arrangement, or setting while keeping the overall thing essentially the same.
This is the all-purpose noun for adapting or changing something, including adjusting one’s communication style.

examples.english: This air-conditioner control needs a small adjustment to get cold enough.
examples.traditional: 呢個冷氣掣要做少少調整先夠凍。

examples.english: You can make a modification to the height of this seat.
examples.traditional: 你可以調整下個座位嘅高度。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 tiu4 zing2 haa5 go3 zo6 wai2 ge3 gou1 dou6

examples.english: To make communication easier for everyone, we need to make a small accommodation.
